title: Portuguese Speaking  Reporter  UK / Brazil
description:
Portuguese Speaking Reporter | €35K | Remote

We’re a global media and events leader at the centre of the iGaming B2B ecosystem — covering the technology, regulation, data, platforms, and commercial engines that power online gaming worldwide. This isn’t consumer‑facing content; it’s the heartbeat of the industry.

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Analista de Produto II
description:
Sumário do cargo:


Responsável por monitorar o ciclo de vida dos SKUs (referência para identificação do produto), identificar oportunidades de melhorias e suportar a gestão de portifólio, visando maximizar a rentabilidade e alinhamento com as necessidades do mercado.



Principais responsabilidades:


Monitorar o ciclo de vida dos SKUs (referência para identificação do produto), através da análise de desempenho, vendas, margens e dados de produção, identificando oportunidades de ajuste no portfólio, buscando garantir e maximizar a rentabilidade e que cada produto esteja alinhado à estratégia e às demandas do mercado.


Avaliar a performance financeira e relevância de cada SKU, considerando custos, margens e volumes de vendas, através de ferramentas analíticas e relatórios gerenciais, em colaboração com equipes de marketing, vendas e supply chain, buscando subsidiar decisões estratégicas sobre manutenção, reposicionamento ou descontinuação de produtos, assegurando a eficiência do portfólio.


Criar relatórios, dashboards e indicadores de performance de portfólio, através do levantamento e consolidação de dados internos e externos, visando fornecer insights confiáveis para a tomada de decisão da liderança e apoiar a gestão dos SKUs (referência para identificação do produto).


Identificar oportunidades e riscos que possam impactar o portfólio, monitorando o mercado e a concorrência através de benchmarking e estudos de tendências, visando manter a competitividade da empresa e antecipar movimentos do mercado.


Apoiar no cronograma de projetos de inovação de novos produtos, através da análise e consolidação de dados, visando garantir o cumprimento de prazos.


Formação:

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.


Local de trabalho:

Barra da Tijuca (Av. Embaixador Abelardo Bueno), Rio de Janeiro.

The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.

Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing

  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Responsibilities

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
  • Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
  • Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
  • Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.

  • Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;

  • Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;

title: LATAM-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.


Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities

·      Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

·      Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

·      Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

·      Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

·      Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

·      Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

·      Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

·      Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

·      Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

·      Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

·      Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

·      Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

·      Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

·      Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

·      Clear and structured written communication skills.

·      Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

·      Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

·      Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

·      Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

·      Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

·      Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

·      Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

·      Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Analista ambiental
description:
Acoem Ambiental | Cliente no Centro do Rio de Janeiro

Posição por tempo determinado – cobertura de férias


A Acoem Ambiental atua com excelência em serviços de monitoramento e gestão ambiental, apoiando clientes na tomada de decisão responsável e sustentável.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Ambiental para atuar junto a um cliente localizado no Centro do Rio de Janeiro , em uma posição por tempo determinado, destinada à cobertura de férias , com atuação técnica consistente, visão analítica e alinhamento aos valores que orientam nosso trabalho: integridade, ousadia e satisfação .


O Papel do Analista Ambiental em nossa Organização


Atuação técnica em projetos de qualidade do ar, emissões atmosféricas e gases de efeito estufa, com foco em análise de dados, conformidade regulatória, estudos ambientais e apoio a processos de licenciamento.


Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais


  • Legislação ambiental aplicada à qualidade do ar, emissões atmosféricas e/ou GEE
  • (CONAMA 506/24, CONAMA 382/06, CONAMA 436/11, NOP-INEA-01, NOP-INEA-52, Resolução INEA/PRES nº 65);
  • Guia Técnico de Qualidade do Ar;
  • Inventários corporativos de gases de efeito estufa (GEE);
  • Licenciamento ambiental com ênfase em emissões atmosféricas e qualidade do ar;
  • Análise de dados de emissões atmosféricas, dados meteorológicos e/ou qualidade do ar;
  • Excel avançado; Power BI; Python e/ou R;
  • Redação técnica clara e objetiva;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Responsabilidades


  • Analisar, validar e interpretar dados de monitoramento de emissões e/ou qualidade do ar;
  • Elaborar e avaliar estudos técnicos, relatórios e pareceres;
  • Executar e acompanhar programas de monitoramento ambiental;
  • Analisar dados de inventários de emissão de gases de efeito estufa;
  • Apoiar processos de licenciamento ambiental e atendimento a condicionantes;
  • Desenvolver estudos e procedimentos para gestão, organização e divulgação de dados ambientais;
  • Realizar vistorias técnicas em empresas atendidas pelos programas de controle.


Formação


  • Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou Química.


Benefícios


  • Vale Alimentação de R$ 45,00 por dia;
  • Vale Combustível;
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco (sem custo para o titular; dependentes conforme faixa etária);
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco (sem custo);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass (opcional);
  • Convênio farmácias EcxCard (opcional);
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Bônus anual atrelado à performance.


Nosso Jeito de Trabalhar


Na Acoem Ambiental , valorizamos profissionais que atuam com ética, responsabilidade e visão técnica, independentemente do tempo de permanência, entregando qualidade, consistência e impacto positivo.

title: Especialista de Projetos
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Executar os projetos da área garantindo o adequado levantamento de requisitos de demandas, classificação, planejamento e controle a fim de executar a entrega das mesmas de acordo com as definições de segurança.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Liderança e Execução: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de projetos, desde a iniciação e planejamento até a execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento.
  • Planejamento: Elaborar cronogramas detalhados, definir escopo, identificar riscos e planejar recursos (equipe, orçamento, materiais).
  • Comunicação: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre stakeholders, equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio.
  • Monitoramento: Realizar o acompanhamento do progresso dos projetos, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas (turn-around).
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo, avaliando seu impacto e garantindo a aprovação e documentação adequadas.
  • Metodologia: Aplicar as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (tradicionais, ágeis ou híbridas), mantendo a documentação e artefatos de projeto atualizados.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para a evolução dos processos e ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos da empresa.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 7 anos) na gestão de projetos de TI e/ou Negócios.
  • Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: PMI/PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban).

title: Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:

  • Conduzir experimentações, provas de conceito (PoCs) e iniciativas de Discovery que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a automação de processos;

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.


Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.

You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.


  • Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).

• Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.

• Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.

• Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.

• Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.
  • Strong experience in Java, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, SQL or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.

Who we are:

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Atuar como parceiro estratégico da gestão industrial, sendo responsável por análises aprofundadas de custos de produção, performance operacional e gestão de estoques, apoiando a tomada de decisão por meio de dados, indicadores e análises críticas, com foco em eficiência, produtividade, rentabilidade e capital de giro.


Principais responsabilidades

- Analisar custos industriais (fixos e variáveis) com foco em eficiência operacional e produtividade.

- Monitorar e explicar variações entre custo orçado, padrão e realizado, identificando causas raiz.

- Avaliar impactos de volume, mix, eficiência, perdas, refugos e utilização de capacidade nos custos.

- Desenvolver análises de custo por produto / família.

- Analisar e acompanhar estoques de matérias-primas, WIP e produtos acabados.

- Monitorar indicadores como giro, cobertura, obsolescência, perdas e acuracidade.

- Apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de políticas de estoque e capital de giro.

- Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs industriais (custo por unidade, OEE, produtividade, custo de conversão).

- Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards (Excel / Power BI).

- Apoiar análises de viabilidade econômica de novos produtos, processos e investimentos.

- Atuar de forma próxima às áreas Industrial e outras.


Diferenciais

- Experiência em ambientes industriais complexos.

- Vivência com projetos de redução de custos e otimização de estoques.


Reporte será para o Gerente Financeiro.


Requisitos

- Formação superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas.

- Experiência sólida em custos industriais, performance operacional e/ou FP&A industrial.

- Vivência com análise de custos de produção e gestão de estoques.

- Excel avançado e conhecimento em Power BI.

- Inglês intermediário a avançado (será testado );

- Desejável experiência em indústria.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.

  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Pessoa Estagiária de Gestão Contratual

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento

Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)

title: Coordenador (a) Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Coordenar as atividades de planejamento regulatório, garantindo a gestão estratégica dos contratos, a análise de impactos regulatórios e a interface com stakeholders internos e externos, com foco na sustentabilidade econômico-financeira da operação.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a equipe de planejamento regulatório.
  • Supervisionar análises de fluxo de caixa, indicadores contratuais e impactos regulatórios.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor com Jurídico, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e consultorias externas.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas a reequilíbrios contratuais, investimentos e pleitos.
  • Garantir governança, qualidade técnica e consistência das informações apresentadas.
  • Atuar fortemente na gestão com visão integrada do contrato.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento regulatório, concessões, PPPs ou gestão de contratos complexos.
  • Forte domínio de análises econômico-financeiras e visão estratégica.
  • Capacidade de liderança, coordenação e desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Perfil analítico, com boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação com múltiplos stakeholders.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

description:

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.

  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.


About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.


What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Observability Implementation)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6 Months

Need to work on PST hours


Mandatory Skills : Snowflake

DBT, Splunk, OpsGenie, Snowflake + Streamlit, Splunk Dashboards and Version Control & IaC


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Senior Data Engineer to drive the execution phase of our migration from Amazon Redshift to Snowflake. The architectural design is complete; we need a builder who can code, implement, and operationalize the solution with a heavy focus on Good Governance, Data Quality, and Observability at scale.

You will pick up where a previous engagement left off, leveraging DBT for transformations and driving the roadmap for 2026. You will work alongside an existing Data Engineer but are expected to lead the implementation with high initiative.


Key Responsibilities

1. Migration & Transformation Execution

  • Lead the Implementation: Execute the transition from Redshift to Snowflake based on existing designs.
  • DBT Transformation: Utilize DBT to manage transformations for DMS (Database Migration Service) outputs and ensure seamless data integration.
  • Code & Drive: This is not a passive role. You will be responsible for writing the code, configuring the environment, and driving the project forward to meet 2026 roadmap goals.
  • Measure Output: Implement metrics to validate and measure the output of DMS processes to ensure accuracy.


2. Data Observability & Alerting at Scale

  • Enterprise Alerting Integration: Operationalize a Proof of Concept (POC) that connects Splunk to OpsGenie .
  • Scale Observability: Deploy observability checks (Freshness, Validity, Volume) across all tables in the ecosystem.
  • Incident Routing: Configure automated workflows to ensure alerts reach the correct contact immediately via OpsGenie.


3. Governance & Quality

  • Data Governance: Enforce \"Good Governance\" practices, including rigorous Data Quality (DQ) checks and comprehensive documentation.
  • Change Management: Manage the change process for data pipelines and schema evolution.
  • Advanced DQ Tooling: Operationalize a DQ POC using Atlan , specifically leveraging its natural language capabilities for data discovery and quality management.


Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • Snowflake (Expert): Deep experience with Snowflake architecture and migration patterns (Redshift to Snowflake preferred).
  • DBT (Required): Strong proficiency in DBT for data modeling and transformation.
  • Observability Stack: Hands-on experience with Splunk and OpsGenie (specifically integrating the two for automated alerting).
  • Data Quality Tools: Familiarity with Atlan or similar modern data governance/catalog tools.
  • AWS DMS: Experience handling output from AWS Database Migration Service or similar migration tools.


Soft Skills & Attributes

  • High Initiative: You are a self-starter who identifies gaps and fixes them without needing constant direction.
  • Execution-Focused: You prefer building and coding over pure theory/design.
  • Communication: Ability to document technical processes clearly for future maintenance.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

We’re looking for a 3D Architectural Visualization Artist with strong Unreal Engine experience to help us create real-time interior apartment walkthroughs. This is not game development. Our work focuses on residential interiors used for sales and marketing.


Our pipeline combines AI-assisted modeling, Blender, Adobe Substance, and Unreal Engine, along with internal tools that automate floor plans and layouts. You’ll be trained on our internal tooling.

  • Interior geometry is created using AI tools and/or manual modeling in Blender
  • Materials and textures are authored in Adobe Substance (Painter/Designer)
  • Scenes are assembled, lit, and optimized in Unreal Engine (UE5)
  • Internal Unreal-connected tools help generate floor plans and unit layouts → Full training provided


Experience working in structured pipelines is important. You will ensure the delivery of visually compelling content, maintain accuracy in architectural representation, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring designs to life. Proficiency in Unreal Engine will be a crucial aspect of daily tasks.


Qualifications

  • Create high-quality interior apartment scenes in Unreal Engine

  • Set up interior lighting (Lumen, reflections, exposure)
  • Build clean, optimized real-time walkthroughs
  • Maintain visual consistency across multiple units and projects
  • Learn and use internal tools connected to Unreal Engine


Requirements

Must-have

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred)
  • Architectural visualization experience (interiors required)
  • Proficiency in Blender or similar DCC tools
  • Experience with Adobe Substance for materials/textures
  • Solid understanding of real-time lighting and performance optimization
  • Portfolio showing Unreal Engine interior walkthroughs


Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with AI-assisted modeling workflows
  • Datasmith workflow experience
  • Apartment or residential interior projects
  • Basic Blueprint knowledge
  • Experience working with internal or proprietary tools
